verdict.rationale: Airwallex clearly supports issuing multi-currency virtual cards with authorization/spend controls that can restrict usage (e.g., merchant/vendor or category rules), which maps to purpose- or vendor-scoped cards, and marketing explicitly touts 'Spend Controls' for corporate cards. However, evidence doesn't explicitly confirm instant/self-serve creation of a card scoped narrowly to a single vendor or ad-spend category by a finance-lead persona, nor any UI walkthrough for this specific use case. Missing for 10: explicit finance-lead-facing UI flow for instant card creation, concrete example of vendor/category-specific scoping (e.g., 'Meta ads only'), and independent/hands-on confirmation of speed/instantness.
